correctness.rationale: For all odd prime powers, the complement indicator identity gives 8U=q-3-J-B; Hasse |J|<=2sqrt(q) and explicit B<=4 for q=3 (mod 4), <=12 for q=1 (mod 4) eliminate orders >=19 and >=29 in the respective classes. I checked the character expansion and the extension-field multiplication conventions. The remaining eight prime powers are exhaustive, not a sample. An independent direct-cover/orbit calculation over every triple in the eight exact fields yields orbit sizes 3:(1), 5:(5,5), 7:(7,21), 9:(6,6,36), 11:(55), 13:(26,39), 17:(68), 25:(100). Two translates can cover only q=3,5 by the intersection identity; the finite group is nonzero square-dilations and translations, NOT all affine or semilinear maps.
